title: New Lyft Go: 8% back on rides + DashPass included
summary: Lyft Go is here. Earn an industry-leading 8% back in Lyft Credits on rides, redeemable on Lyft rides or DoorDash, with DashPass included for $9.99 a month.
body_markdown:
*Two memberships for the price of one, with the ability to earn 8% back in Lyft Credits on rides, claim a complimentary DashPass membership, and double donations to the causes you care about. Redeem credits on Lyft or DoorDash.*


SAN FRANCISCO — Nov. 5, 2026 — Lyft, Inc (Nasdaq: LYFT) today announced[Lyft Go](https://www.lyft.com/lyft-go) , a new, best-in-class membership that rewards riders who choose Lyft with credits they can put toward their next ride or DoorDash order. Lyft Go rolls out across the U.S. starting Nov. 5, 2026, and marks the latest expansion of Lyft's growing partnership with DoorDash.


**What is Lyft Go with DashPass?**


Lyft Go with DashPass turns everyday rides into everyday benefits. For $9.99 a month, Lyft Go with DashPass raises the bar for rideshare membership. Riders earn an industry-leading 8% back in Lyft Credits on rides from Wait & Save to Lyft Black, which they can redeem on Lyft rides or DoorDash orders.


**Lyft Go with DashPass benefits**


It’s two memberships for the price of one, with a ride today helping you cover your DoorDash order tomorrow. New and existing DashPass members will be able to link their accounts and unlock Lyft Go at no added cost.


In addition to 8% credits back for use on rides or DoorDash orders, Lyft Go members also get:


-


[DashPass by DoorDash](http://www.doordash.com/lyft) **membership,** which means $0 delivery fees, reduced service fees, and exclusive savings on eligible orders, an added value of $120 a year.


-


**Three relaxed cancellations** per month, giving riders more wiggle room for when life happens.


-


**Automatic donation matching** that lets members make more change with their spare change. When members opt in to Round Up & Donate to support a cause they choose, Lyft will match 100% of their charitable donation, doubling their impact. In 2025 alone, Lyft riders donated over $5M via Round Up & Donate.


-


Leave something behind? The **Lost Item Fee Waiver** means you won’t pay a fee for the return trip, with unlimited uses.


**Lyft Go Core: price and benefits**


The company will also offer Lyft Go Core, a low-cost membership tier without DashPass, which earns 5% back in rideshare-only credits for $4.99 a month, and includes relaxed ride cancellations and automatic Round Up & Donate donation matching.


**Lyft is also making it easier to skip the wait for your next meal.** On select trips, Lyft riders — no membership required — can browse nearby DoorDash restaurants right in the Lyft app and start an order before their trip even ends, so by the time they walk through the door, dinner is already on its way.


"Lyft is already part of millions of people’s everyday lives. Now we’re showing up for more of the moments that matter. With Lyft Go, your ride to work or your ride home from the airport can help cover the cost of dinner. Together with DoorDash we’ve created a best-in-class membership program that raises the bar for the industry." — Siddharth Patil, Chief Rideshare Officer, Lyft


“At DoorDash, we're always looking for new ways to deepen the value we bring to our members. Millions of people already count on DashPass to save on dinner, groceries, and retail, and our continued partnership with Lyft takes that even further, turning your everyday rides into everyday rewards. With a ride now earning you credits toward your next order or Lyft ride, it's just one more way DashPass is becoming your all-access pass to everyday life, helping you save on what matters most.” — Rob Edell, VP of DashPass, DoorDash


**Overview**


**Lyft Go with DashPass ($9.99/month or $96/year):** Members earn 8% back in Lyft Credits, redeemable on Lyft rides – from Wait & Save to Lyft Black – or DoorDash orders, with a DashPass membership included at no additional cost. Also includes relaxed cancellations, automatic Round Up & Donate donation matching, and lost item fee waivers.


**Lyft Go Core ($4.99/month):** An affordable program offering 5% back in Lyft Credits, redeemable on Lyft rides. Also includes relaxed cancellations and automatic Round Up & Donate donation matching.


Beginning Nov. 5, 2026, riders can join either tier of Lyft Go directly in the Lyft app, and start with a one-month free trial. Existing Lyft Pink members will be notified in advance and automatically transitioned to Lyft Go with DashPass at no change to their current price and will start receiving its benefits, with the option to activate DashPass in the app. They can easily opt to cancel in the app before their renewal date. Lyft Pink All-Access is not changing, and those members will keep their current benefits.


[Terms apply](https://www.lyft.com/terms/rider-membership)


**See what you could earn with Lyft Go**


Curious how quickly Lyft Go adds up? Use our credits estimator to see what you could earn based on the rides you take each month, and when your membership could pay for itself. *Estimates only, based on a $20 average eligible fare.*

At 10 rides a month, Lyft Go with DashPass members come out **$6 ahead** of Uber One members, and Lyft Go Core members **$5 ahead** for half the price.


This tool estimates credits earned based only on the user’s input of rides taken per month, assuming a $20 average eligible fare (the base fare, excluding taxes, tolls, tips and fees, and any portion paid with discounts or coupons). It is an estimate only and does not guarantee the value of credits earned, which would be based on actual eligible ride spend with the membership. Credits back are earned on eligible rides only, for a maximum of $40/mo with “Lyft Go with DashPass” and a maximum of $20/mo with “Lyft Go Core.” “Net credits” as estimated by the tool are credits earned minus the monthly membership cost. Lyft Go also includes the option to claim a complimentary DashPass membership, which isn’t counted here ($9.99/month value). All estimates are based on U.S. memberships only.


**About Lyft**


Whether it’s an everyday commute or a journey that changes everything, Lyft is driven by our purpose: to serve and connect. Founded in 2012, Lyft has grown into a global mobility platform offering a mix of rideshare, taxis, private hire vehicles, executive chauffeur services, car sharing, bikes, and scooters across six continents and thousands of cities. Millions of drivers have chosen to earn on billions of rides - helping to create a more connected world, with transportation options for everyone.


**About DoorDash**


DoorDash (NASDAQ: DASH) is one of the world's leading local commerce platforms that helps businesses of all kinds grow and innovate, connects consumers to the best of their neighborhoods, and gives people fast, flexible ways to earn. Since its founding in 2013, DoorDash has expanded to more than 40 countries, using technology and logistics to shape the future of local commerce and broaden access to opportunity. With a growing international presence that now includes Deliveroo and Wolt, DoorDash combines global scale with local expertise to serve communities around the world.


**FAQs**


**What are the Lyft Go membership tiers?** Lyft Go with DashPass for $9.99 a month: members earn 8% back in Lyft Credits, redeemable on Lyft rides — from Wait & Save to Lyft Black — or DoorDash orders. Lyft Go Core for $4.99 a month: an affordable program offering 5% back in Lyft Credits, redeemable on Lyft rides only.


**Why should a rider choose Lyft Go?** At 8% back in Lyft Credits, Lyft Go with DashPass is the highest credit earn rate of any US rideshare membership. It also includes a full DashPass membership, which you can activate to claim $0 delivery fees and reduced service fees on eligible DoorDash orders.


**Is there a free trial for Lyft Go?** Yes, riders can join Lyft Go starting November 5, 2026 and enjoy a one-month free trial.


**What happens to the Lyft Pink members?** Pink paid members will automatically become Lyft Go with DashPass members at their next auto-renewal date. If they choose not to continue the membership, they can cancel in the Lyft app.


**Does anything change for Lyft Business Travel Rewards members?** No, the Lyft Business Travel Rewards program and benefits will stay the same.


**What about Pink All Access or Chase co-branded members?** All Access members will remain unchanged, and maintain their current benefit offering.


**What about Chase cardholders who have a DashPass benefit?** Eligible Chase cardmembers who receive complimentary DashPass can now also claim Lyft Go at no additional cost, which unlocks benefits including 8% back in Lyft Credits on Lyft rides that can be spent on DoorDash or Lyft. Cardmembers with an activated DashPass can claim Lyft Go now[here](https://www.doordash.com/dashpass/partner/lyft?entry_point=Chase_Tri_Party) or on the DoorDash app, while cardmembers who haven't activated DashPass should do so first to then unlock both benefits. To learn more, please visit:[https://www.doordash.com/dashpass/partner/chase/card](https://www.doordash.com/dashpass/partner/chase/card) .


**What happens to riders who already have a linked DashPass account?** For current DashPass users who have already linked their accounts to Lyft, you will need to claim Lyft Go in the DoorDash app.


**Can riders use Lyft Credits earned through Lyft Go on DoorDash?** Yes, with Lyft Go and DashPass, credits can go toward Lyft rides or DoorDash orders. Credits earned through Lyft Go Core can only be used on Lyft.


**Do Lyft Credits expire?** Yes — all earned credits carry a 60-day expiration window from the date they're earned. If your membership ends, your credits may become unavailable or expire sooner. See the Lyft Go Terms for details.


**Is the currency two-way — can DoorDash spend also earn Lyft Credits?** No. Members earn Lyft Credits by riding with Lyft, and can then choose to redeem those credits on either a Lyft ride or a DoorDash order.
